name: seis-plugin-discovery
description: Browse public SEIS Repo cards and inspect selected local plugin metadata without executing code.

interface.shortDescription: Browse public SEIS Repo cards and selected metadata safely.
interface.longDescription: Read the public SEIS Repo catalog or inspect an explicitly selected directory without executing code, following symlinks, copying data, or scanning the device.
interface.defaultPrompt: Show the public SEIS Repo plugin catalog or discover plugins in an explicitly selected directory.
